alternatives.option: eager construction at createApiHandler closure time

context: TRIAGE-SPEC §7 HTTP adapter (PR-stage 3b): added GET /api/triage to src/dashboard/api-routes.ts (parsed-pathname match, §4.1 HTTP param handling, existsSync zero shape with initialized:false, createStores-based store construction built once per closure) plus test/dashboard/triage-api.test.ts covering §10.14 HTTP-side and §10.11 HTTP zero shape. Full npm test (1378 passed, 2 skipped) and npm run build green.
rationale: spec §7 says 'the same position as the existing fallback', but eager createStores on an uninitialized project would open/create .twining/twining.db, flipping the existsSync guard and breaking uninitialized semantics; lazy-once still satisfies 'built ONCE, never per request'.
summary: Chose lazy-once construction of the triage StoreSet (getTriageStores mirroring getSearchEngines) over eager construction at createApiHandler closure time
